purpose: A bilingual administrative reference draft for application development and candidate name/code matching. It is not an officially verified OCHA gazetteer.

secondary.name: Open Admin Data - Afghanistan Administrative Divisions
secondary.role: Secondary candidate reference; local-script labels are not assumed to be verified Pashto or Dari official spellings.

primary.name: OCHA/HDX Afghanistan - Subnational Administrative Boundaries (COD-AB)
primary.source_authority: Afghanistan Geodesy and Cartography Head Office (AGCHO)
primary.notes: The official metadata confirms the dataset and coverage, but this draft does not yet contain a verified row-by-row P-code comparison against its gazetteer.

rules: Treat IDs from the secondary source as candidate identifiers only until checked against the OCHA COD-AB gazetteer.
Do not use these records to overwrite existing application IDs or user-supplied IDs.
Preserve original source spellings and add reviewed aliases separately; never silently normalize names.
Do not publish district-specific agricultural recommendations solely because an administrative code is present.
Keep this file separate from runtime advisory data until primary-source verification is complete.

workbook_records_not_in_candidate_refere.note: These are additional workbook ADM2 records; they are not silently added to the candidate reference.

notes: All 401 candidate ADM2 P-codes are present in the supplied workbook and all 401 parent province P-codes match.
The 401 candidate ADM2 entries are not 401 ordinary districts: their workbook unit types are 367 District, 30 Provincial Capital, 3 Temporaray District, and 1 Capital.
The workbook has 56 additional ADM2 records outside the candidate reference: 30 District and 26 Temporaray District.
The 457 workbook ADM2 rows must not be described as 457 districts or equated directly with the OCHA metadata's declared 401-district coverage.
Province name differences are recorded as variants and have not been normalized or promoted to official spellings.
District name-by-name comparison remains pending; P-code presence and parent-code matching do not certify names.
This workbook comparison does not constitute independent OCHA/AGCHO certification.
The full 401-record candidate-to-workbook district-name comparison has not yet been completed; do not infer name equality from P-code and parent-code matches.
